title: Honky Tonk
style: Duet, Good time country, dance music, honky tonk
lyrics:
[Country Comedy Duet]
[Intro – male female duet]
DJ crank that twang up higher
We’re ‘bout to set this floor on fire.
(And if it ain’t the boots... well, it might be the chili from last night.)
“Don’t blame me for that!”

[Verse 1 – Him]
Girl, you walked in hotter than a July fair
With that smile so sweet it oughta need a permit to wear.
Every cowboy dropped his drink when you hit that floor—
One even fell off his barstool, bless his heart, poor boy.
[Verse 1 – Her]
Now hold up, cowboy, don’t get ahead of yourself
I ain’t melted nothin’ but his ego—and maybe his belt.
But when you strutted over with that “I can dance” grin
I thought, well, this’ll be fun when he falls again.

[Chorus – Both]
We got boots on fire, sparks flyin’ wide
He’s two steps shaky, she’s a rodeo ride.
Kickin’ up dust like a runaway tire
Settin’ off smoke alarms with these boots on fire.
Laughin’ all night as we spin higher
Baby, we got boots on fire.

[Verse 2 – Him]
Girl, you’re blowin’ up the dance floor, you know that’s true
One twirl from you and the jukebox froze like, “Well dang, who knew?”
You got me sweatin’ like a preacher on payday
Tryin’ to keep up with your wild little sway.
[Verse 2 – Her]
Boy, you talk big talk, but your steps say “pray for me,”
You’re hangin’ on my arm like a busted Christmas tree.
But I’ll give you this—you got charm and desire
Even if your boots ain’t smokin’, just your pants catch fire.

[Chorus – Both]
We got boots on fire, bless this floor
If the owner sees the damage, we’re banned for sure.
Two-step heat like a barnyard pyre
Tonight we’re burnin’ with these boots on fire.
Hold me close, spin me higher
Baby, we got boots on fire.

[Bridge – Playful Back-and-Forth]
Him: Maybe it’s the whiskey...
Her: Maybe it’s your bad aim...
Him: Hey! I only stepped on your foot twice—
Her: Boy, your feet are a weapon—they should come with a flame.
Both
But whatever it is, we ain’t slowin’ down
We’re the hottest mess in this honky-tonk town.

[Verse 3 – Long, Comedic]
Him
Girl, you dance like a dream with a wild streak in between
I’m tryin’ real hard not to trip on this slippery ol’ scene.
But with you laughin’ at me, I don’t mind lookin’ dumb—
Just warn me next time before the spin makes me numb.
Her
Oh hush now, cowboy, you’re doin’ just fine
You only crashed into four tables—maybe five.
But I’ll keep you dancin’ ‘til the whole place fries
’Cause the sparks we’re throwin’ got folks shieldin’ their eyes.

[Chorus – Both]
Boots on fire, hearts gone wild
We’re the chaos couple, honky-tonk style.
Spinnin’ like wheels on a mud-slick wire
Lord have mercy, we got boots on fire.
One more round, bartender—higher!
’Cause tonight we’re burnin’ with boots on fire.

[Outro – Both, Laughing]
If the fire truck shows, don’t blame us
We just came here to dance, raise a little fuss.
But if our boots melt straight to the floor...
“Well girl, you’re carryin’ me out that door.”
“Oh no, cowboy—YOU are carryin’ ME.”
Boots on fiiiiiire!
